<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// --- Gateway & currency settings ---
$s = get_option('smartpay_settings', []);
$s['default_gateway'] = 'manual';
$s['gateways'] = ['manual' => 1];
$s['currency'] = 'USD';
$s['currency_position'] = 'before';
$s['decimal_separator'] = '.';
$s['thousands_separator'] = ',';
update_option('smartpay_settings', $s, false);

// --- Quick Donation form ---
$content =
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name {"showMiddleName":false} -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-field {"sub":"first"} -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-label /-->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-input /-->' .
    '<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/name-field -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-field {"sub":"last"} -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-label /-->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/name-input /-->' .
    '<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/name-field -->' .
    '<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/name -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/email -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/email-label /-->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/email-input /-->' .
    '<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/email -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing {"allowCustomAmount":true,"customAmountLabel":"Or enter a custom amount"} -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing-option {"key":"small","label":"$10","amount":"10","billing_type":"One Time"} /-->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing-option {"key":"medium","label":"$25","amount":"25","billing_type":"One Time"} /-->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/pricing-option {"key":"large","label":"$50","amount":"50","billing_type":"One Time"} /-->' .
    '<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/pricing -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/submit-button -->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/submit-coupon /-->' .
    '<!-- wp:smartpay-form/submit-pay /-->' .
    '<!-- /wp:smartpay-form/submit-button -->';

$form_id = wp_insert_post([
    'post_title'   => 'Quick Donation',
    'post_content' => $content,
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_type'    => 'smartpay_form',
]);

if ($form_id && !is_wp_error($form_id)) {
    update_post_meta($form_id, '_smartpay_amounts', json_encode([
        ['key' => 'small',  'label' => '$10', 'amount' => 10, 'billing_type' => 'One Time'],
        ['key' => 'medium', 'label' => '$25', 'amount' => 25, 'billing_type' => 'One Time'],
        ['key' => 'large',  'label' => '$50', 'amount' => 50, 'billing_type' => 'One Time'],
    ]));
}

$fid = ($form_id && !is_wp_error($form_id)) ? $form_id : 1;

// --- Donate Now page ---
$page_id = wp_insert_post([
    'post_title'   => 'Donate Now',
    'post_name'    => 'donate-now',
    'post_content' => '<!-- wp:shortcode -->[smartpay_form id="' . $fid . '"]<!-- /wp:shortcode -->',
    'post_status'  => 'publish',
    'post_type'    => 'page',
]);

// --- Nav menu: Donate Now + Dashboard only ---
$menu_id = wp_create_nav_menu('Main Menu');
if (!is_wp_error($menu_id)) {
    wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu_id, 0, [
        'menu-item-title'     => 'Donate Now',
        'menu-item-object'    => 'page',
        'menu-item-object-id' => $page_id,
        'menu-item-type'      => 'post_type',
        'menu-item-status'    => 'publish',
    ]);
    wp_update_nav_menu_item($menu_id, 0, [
        'menu-item-title'  => 'Dashboard',
        'menu-item-url'    => admin_url(),
        'menu-item-type'   => 'custom',
        'menu-item-status' => 'publish',
    ]);
    // Assign to all registered theme locations
    $locs = get_registered_nav_menus();
    set_theme_mod('nav_menu_locations', array_fill_keys(array_keys($locs), $menu_id));
}

// --- Seed 5 sample donations ---
global $wpdb;
$tp = $wpdb->prefix . 'smartpay_payments';
$tc = $wpdb->prefix . 'smartpay_customers';
$donors = [
    ['Sarah',  'Mitchell', 'sarah@example.com',  25, 'medium'],
    ['James',  'Okafor',   'james@example.com',  50, 'large'],
    ['Emily',  'Chen',     'emily@example.com',  10, 'small'],
    ['Marcus', 'Williams', 'marcus@example.com', 25, 'medium'],
    ['Aisha',  'Patel',    'aisha@example.com',  100, 'custom'],
];
foreach ($donors as $i => $d) {
    $existing = $wpdb->get_var($wpdb->prepare("SELECT id FROM {$tc} WHERE email=%s", $d[2]));
    if (!$existing) {
        $wpdb->insert($tc, ['first_name' => $d[0], 'last_name' => $d[1], 'email' => $d[2]]);
        $cid = $wpdb->insert_id;
    } else {
        $cid = $existing;
    }
    $wpdb->insert($tp, [
        'type'           => 'form_payment',
        'data'           => json_encode(['form_id' => $fid, 'key' => $d[4]]),
        'amount'         => $d[3],
        'currency'       => 'USD',
        'gateway'        => 'manual',
        'transaction_id' => 'DEMO-' . strtoupper(substr(md5($d[2] . $i), 0, 8)),
        'customer_id'    => $cid,
        'email'          => $d[2],
        'key'            => md5($d[2] . $i . time()),
        'mode'           => 'Live',
        'status'         => 'completed',
        'completed_at'   => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', strtotime('-' . (($i + 1) * 3) . ' days')),
    ]);
}

echo 'Done. Form ID: ' . $fid . ', Page ID: ' . $page_id . ', Menu ID: ' . $menu_id;
